GetInstanceRecordConfig.description_en: Queries the screen recording configuration of an instance
GetInstanceRecordConfig.description_zh: 查询实例对应的录屏配置

ListInstanceRecords.description_en: Queries the list of screen recording records for an instance
ListInstanceRecords.description_zh: 查询实例录屏记录列表

ListTerminalCommands.description_en: Queries the history of commands executed after logging on to the instance Workbench
ListTerminalCommands.description_zh: 查看实例Workbench登录后执行命令的历史列表

LoginInstance.description_en: Logs on to an ECS instance
LoginInstance.description_zh: 登录ECS实例，使用此API可以登录ECS实例

SetInstanceRecordConfig.description_en: Configures the screen recording settings for an instance, including creating, updating, and disabling the settings
SetInstanceRecordConfig.description_zh: 配置实例录屏配置，包括新增、更新和关闭录屏配置

ViewInstanceRecords.description_en: Retrieves the screen recording of an instance and checks whether you have permissions to access the recording
ViewInstanceRecords.description_zh: 查看实例录屏内容，该API可以判断对实例录屏内容是否有权限
